points.why: It hints at competing pressures (deadline clustering, velocity incentives) but never frames the workarounds as a balancing loop defending an unwritten throughput or cycle-time goal.
It never sketches state, goal, gap and correction, and never asks who set the implicit goal; 'decide what the policy is for' concerns the policy's own goal.
It advises redesigning the policy and making exceptions explicit rather than enforcing harder, but never says to renegotiate the competing implicit goal itself.
